internal.title: High Error Rate Detected in Frontend Service - Escalated for Further Investigation
internal.body: At 10:19 UTC, an alert was triggered for a high error rate (35%) in the frontend service. Initial diagnosis rounds found no conclusive evidence supporting error injection, dependency failures, or resource exhaustion as the root cause. Elevated latency was observed but did not fully explain the error rate increase. After multiple diagnosis rounds and replanning, no hypothesis was sufficiently supported by the available evidence. The incident was escalated to the on-call engineer for deeper investigation at 10:39 UTC. Further updates will follow as more information becomes available.

external.title: Intermittent Errors Observed in Frontend Service
external.body: Between 10:19 and 10:39 UTC, some customers may have experienced intermittent errors when using the frontend service. Our engineering team detected elevated error rates and latency during this period and is actively investigating the cause. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience as we work to resolve the issue.
